source_read_through: web tool; direct HTML download timed out
reported_mechanism: Exposed enclave signing key and unchecked application DEBUG flag; forged proposal age bypassed permissionless proving delay; fake checkpoints authorized false bridge withdrawals.
loss_boundary: Official total includes an 18 ETH relayer payout to a third-party MEV bot, not all funds went to the attacker. Unpaid claims and remaining reserves are not added to realized withdrawals.
reported_recapitalization: Official report says the bridge was recollateralized 1:1 before reopening on July 2; this is not evidence all stolen funds were recovered.
